reviews.t: GREAT HELP TO THOSE WHO ARE BEDRIDDEN

NOT ONLY WAS IT SIMPLE TO USE BUT IT MADE ALL OF THE DIFFERENCE TO MY MOM'S WELL BEING.  SHE HAS BEEN SO SICK AND REALLY CAN'T DO ANYTHING FOR HERSELF AND YOUR PRODUCT MADE HER FEEL HUMAN AGAIN. Very pleased to find a way to wash hair out of the shower & not in a basin. Has very nice aroma, but believe it's leave-in conditioner that makes it very sticky - doesn't come out squeaky clean. Good thing - gives hair lots of body.

Great product for those who have trouble getting out of bed, or those who have trouble getting into a bath tub or shower and want to keep up their hygiene practices. The only reason I did not mark it 5/5 stars is because, at least in my case, the day after you use it, your hair seems to be kind of greasy and sticky for a few hours in the morning to mid-afternoon. After that, your hair seems to be soft and silky smooth. If you can deal with that (or, maybe who knows, it may not happen to you?) th

My husband was recently in the hospital after surgery and the nurse brought us one of these, after I had tried to WASH his hair with him sitting in his bed. This shampoo cap was so easy to use. You just rub their hair and head with it--it's very relaxing as it is warmed up first in the microwave! Then I towel dried his hair and it looked so much cleaner and smelled great. I highly recommend this product. In fact, I am ordering more  for my teenage daughter who is tired of washing her hair every
Used it on my 80 year old mother when she was hospitalized. Worked extremely well, left her hair clean, shiny and smelling wonderfully fresh. So easy to use and no mess at all!

These are wonderful. We simply heat it in the microwave for about 30 seconds, put it on my mothers head and massage the shampoo in. Then dry her hair with a towel and comb it out. She doesnt like to wash her hair as much as we like her too. These work great. They are easy to use and made to last. The hair does not have to be rinsed out and it smells clean and fresh.

Very nice product.  The hospital gave my wife one of these to use and she loved it.  Leaves hair nice and clean.  Very nice feeling when you heat them in the microwave for 30 sec.  This was exactly what the hospital uses

Fabulous product for bed ridden individuals or people that are unable to have shower right after surgery but need their hair washed. Great for camping trips. I have used these for all the above mentioned.  Just like washing your hair in the shower.  Hair is wet after use and can be blow dried and styled as usual. reviews.t: Not like a real shampoo job
reviews.x: We used this product for an alzheimer patient for convenience. It is easy and quick but the hair isn't as lifelike as it is after a water shampoo job. Nevertheless, it is a lot easier!

I have been recovering from a hospital stay. Unable to walk, and crazy weak, I still needed to wash my hair. After use, my hair didn't feel as clean as I like, but it looked clean and felt soft. It also smelled a lot better.

Great for those times when you can't wash your hair in the conventional manner (e.g., in the hospital).  I was amazed at how well it worked!  I have bought a couple of these to keep on hand "just in case."

reviews.t: If you want a shampoo cap that doesn't run all over the patient's face
reviews.x: I realize that this is one of the more expensive options but it's the brand our hospital was using so I tried it after trying others. I always try them on myself before using them for my mother. This one the product stays in the cap.

reviews.t: It stinks. It smells of chemicals very strong. ...
reviews.x: It stinks.It smells of chemicals very strong. Would not buy again.

reviews.t: Too much conditioner. Hair becomes heavy, lumpy, and waxy after use. Easy to use.
reviews.x: This is for my wife who has short and thick hair undergo a surgery and is not ready for shower/hair wash on her own. It's easy to use, to be fair to say. But after massaging the shampoo/conditioners onto her sculps for 4 minutes and turns out her hair is very lumpy (feeling very heavy) and waxy to the touch. This Rinse-Free Shampoo Cap helped so much after my husband came home from the hospital. He couldn't take a shower but wanted his hair washed.  It is very convenient, not messy, and does a great job cleaning the hair. We found out about them in the hospital when  a very sweet CNA  got him one and washed his hair there.

reviews.t: OK for hair that is not too dirty, I guess
reviews.x: It didn't work very well. OK for hair that is not too dirty, I guess. I had three caps, and only worked decently once. Hair still looks dirty, but not greasy. Do not like shampoo caps. Wouldn't recommend them.

It's a fantastic product for a person w shower limitations or restrictions on raising the arms. Works really well for a caregiver to wash a patient's hair, which helps the patient to feel so much better.
When I had MOHS surgery on my scalp, this shampoo cap saved the day for cleaning my hair when I couldn't get my hair wet. It was super to have.[[ASIN:B0002DO11E Comfort Bath® Rinse-Free Shampoo Cap]]
MY FATHER IS BED BOUND.  AND HE LOVES HIS HAIR WASHED EVERYDAY.  BUT WITH THIE PRODUCT HE WILL WAIT TWO TO THREE DAYS IN BETWEEN.  MAKES HIS HAIR SMELL FRESH. EASY NO MESS AND HE LOVES IT.
I found the product to be easy and effective. The down side is the cost--more than $6.00 for one use.  That is a very expensive hair washing session.
was looking for something like this, Mom can't get in the shower or to the sink to wash her hair as often as she would like... These are easy to use
Does not clean good if hair is a little oily. Did not seem to complete clean hair and next day it felt still dirty.
This shampoo cap no rinse is a big help, just warm for 30 secs massage all over the head, and it’s very relaxing

i bought this for my ill mother i dont know if i used it wrong or it didnt work but i didnt care for it.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product as easy to use and convenient, especially for bedridden or recovering patients.
Many reviewers say it leaves hair clean, soft, and fresh-smelling, and several learned about it in the hospital.
Some reviewers report the hair does not feel as clean as after a regular water shampoo, with residue or heaviness.
A few reviewers complain about the scent, with one describing a strong chemical smell.
Reviewers note the warmed cap is relaxing and the product stays in the cap without making a mess.
